panels.description: Validator uptime over time. Series: uptime = time since validator boot (nanoseconds; auto-scaled).
panels.title: Validator Uptime

panels.description: Tile state over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is status (0=booting, 1=running, 2=shutdown).
panels.title: Tile Status

panels.description: Tile busy share over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is share of time the tile spends outside caught_up regimes.
panels.title: Tile Busy %

panels.description: Approximate time since each tile last heartbeated. Computed as current Prometheus scrape time minus tile_heartbeat_time, converted from nanoseconds to seconds.
panels.title: Tile Heartbeat Age

panels.description: Backpressure event rate by tile. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is how often the tile had to wait for consumers to catch up before publishing.
panels.title: Tile Backpressure Rate

panels.description: Tile backpressure state over time. Series: each line is a tile (kind/kind_id); value is 1 when backpressured, 0 otherwise.
panels.title: Tile Backpressure

panels.description: Rates of tile_context_switch_involuntary and tile_context_switch_voluntary per tile.
panels.title: Tile Context Switch Rates

panels.description: Link health rates for producer/consumer pressure. Series: overrun_polling = link overrun while polling; overrun_reading = link overrun while reading; slow = producer detected consumer throttling.
panels.title: Link Overruns / Slow

panels.description: Link fragment flow and drop rates. Series: consumed = fragments consumed by the link reader; filtered = fragments filtered and not consumed; overrun_poll_frag = fragments not processed because the link was overrun while polling; overrun_read_frag = fragments not processed because the link was overrun while reading.
panels.title: Link Fragments

panels.description: Net tile packet rates. Series: rx = packets received by the net tile; tx = packet transmit completions by the net tile.
panels.title: Net Packets (PPS)

panels.description: Net tile byte rates. Series: rx = bytes received; tx = bytes transmitted.
panels.title: Net Bytes (B/s)

panels.description: Net tile packet drop/failure rates. Series: tx_fail = transmit route/neighbor/full-ring/GRE/XDP failures; rx_drop = receive malformed/address/port/GRE drops, fill-ring stalls and XDP drops.
panels.title: Net Drops

panels.description: Net tile XSK wakeup syscall rates. Series: xsk_rx_wakeup = XSK recvmsg wakeups; xsk_tx_wakeup = XSK sendto wakeups.
panels.title: Net XSK Wakeups

panels.description: Inbound TPU transaction rates by receive type. Series: each line is a tpu_rx_type; value is TPU transactions received via that path (udp, quic_fast, quic_frag).
panels.title: QUIC Transactions Received

panels.description: QUIC wire byte rates. Series: rx = bytes received (includes IP/UDP/QUIC headers); tx = bytes sent (includes headers).
panels.title: QUIC Bytes (B/s)

panels.description: QUIC connection counts by state. Series: each line is a quic_conn_state; value is current connections in that state.
panels.title: QUIC Connections by State

panels.description: QUIC packet error/drop rates by cause. Series: crypto_failed = packets dropped due to decrypt failure; no_key = packets dropped due to missing key; no_conn = packets dropped for unknown connection; wrong_src = packets dropped due to wrong source IP; oversz = packets dropped for being too large; undersz = packets dropped for being too small; quic_header_invalid = packets dropped for invalid QUIC header; net_header_invalid = packets dropped for invalid IP/UDP header.
panels.title: QUIC Packet Errors

panels.description: QUIC processing latency percentiles. Series: receive_p50/p95/p99 = packet processing duration; service_p50/p95/p99 = service loop duration.
panels.title: QUIC Durations (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: QUIC connection lifecycle event rates. Series: created/closed/aborted/timed_out/retried = connection lifecycle events; no_slots = connection creation failures due to no slots; retry_fail = retry failures.
panels.title: QUIC Connection Lifecycle

panels.description: QUIC transaction fragment, reassembly, and size-drop rates. Series: reasms_started = fragmented transaction reassembly starts; frags_ok = transaction fragments received; frags_gap = fragments dropped due to gaps; frags_dup = fragments dropped as duplicates; txns_overrun = transactions dropped due to reassembly overrun; txns_abandoned = transactions abandoned because a connection was lost; txn_undersz/txn_oversz = QUIC transactions dropped by size; legacy_txn_undersz/legacy_txn_oversz = non-QUIC TPU packets dropped by transaction size.
panels.title: QUIC Reassembly / Fragments

panels.description: QUIC handshake pressure rates. Series: created = handshakes created; alloc_fail = handshakes dropped due to allocation failure; evicted = handshakes evicted.
panels.title: QUIC Handshake Alloc/Evict

panels.description: QUIC packet traffic and reliability rates. Series: rx_packets = packets received; tx_packets = packets sent; retransmits = packets retransmitted; retry_sent = retry packets sent; verneg = version negotiation packets received.
panels.title: QUIC Packets / Retransmits

panels.description: Current allocated connections (quic_conn_capacity - quic_conn_free) and quic_txn_reassembly_pending, plus quic_frame_parse_failed rate.
panels.title: QUIC Connections / Reassembly

panels.description: Rates of quic_pkt_ack_processed outcomes, top quic_frame_rx types, and quic_pkt_meta_acquire_attempted outcomes.
panels.title: QUIC ACK / Frame Rates

panels.description: Verify-stage transaction error and gossip vote rates. Series: parse_failure = transactions that failed to parse; dedup_failure = transactions that failed dedup in verify stage; verify_failure = transactions that failed signature verification; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure; gossip_votes = simple vote transactions received via gossip.
panels.title: Verify Failures

panels.description: Dedup-stage transaction error and gossip vote rates. Series: dedup_failure = transactions that failed dedup in dedup stage; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure; gossip_votes = simple vote transactions received via gossip.
panels.title: Dedup Failures

panels.description: Resolv-stage drop/error rates. Series: blockhash_expired = transactions dropped due to expired blockhash; no_bank_drop = transactions dropped due to missing bank; bundle_peer_failure = transactions dropped due to bundle peer failure.
panels.title: Resolv Errors

panels.description: Resolv stash operation rates. Series: inserted = transactions stashed for unknown blockhash; published = stashed transactions published when the blockhash resolved; failed = stashed transactions removed without publish; evicted = transactions dropped because the stash was full.
panels.title: Resolv Stash Ops

panels.description: Pack transaction pool size by type. Series: all = total pending transactions available to schedule; regular = non-vote transactions in main treap; vote = simple vote transactions; conflicting = transactions writing hot accounts; bundle = transactions that are part of a bundle.
panels.title: Pack Available Transactions

panels.description: Pack pool capacity utilization. Series: utilization = percent of pack pending transaction capacity currently filled by available transactions.
panels.title: Pack Pool Utilization %

panels.description: Pack scheduling decision rates. Series: taken = transaction scheduled; cu_limit = skipped due to block CU limit; conflict_fast = skipped due to account conflict (fast check); byte_limit = skipped due to block data limit; alloc_limit = skipped due to block data allocation limit; write_cost = skipped due to per-account write cost limit; conflict_slow = skipped due to account conflict (full check); write_cost_deferred = skipped after repeated per-account write cost limit.
panels.title: Pack Schedule Outcomes

panels.description: Pack transaction drop rates by reason. Series: expired = transactions dropped because TTL expired; evicted = transactions evicted from pack to make room for others; partial_bundle = transactions dropped because part of a partial bundle; already_executed = transactions dropped because already executed.
panels.title: Pack Drop Reasons

panels.description: Pack scheduling/complete/insert latency percentiles. Series: schedule_p50/p95/p99 = time to schedule a microblock; complete_p50/p95/p99 = time to complete a microblock; insert_p50/p95/p99 = time to insert a transaction into pack.
panels.title: Pack Latency (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Compute unit usage percentiles per pack. Series: p50/p95/p99 = percent of block CU limit used per pack.
panels.title: Pack CU Usage

panels.description: Pack input vs accepted transaction rates. Series: received = normal TPU transactions received; inserted = transactions accepted into pack.
panels.title: Pack Input vs Inserted

panels.description: Pack insertion outcome rates. Series: each line is a pack_txn_insert_result outcome; value is insert attempts that returned that outcome.
panels.title: Pack Insert Outcomes (Top 6)

panels.description: Pack time distribution by state. Series: each line is a pack_schedule_regime; value is percent of time pack spent in that state.
panels.title: Pack Timing State %

panels.description: Pack block-level limit hit rates. Series: microblock_limit = pack could not pack due to microblock-per-block limit; data_limit = pack could not pack due to data-per-block limit.
panels.title: Pack Limit Hits

panels.description: Mean scheduler/insert/complete pack durations from *_sum/*_count rate ratios.
panels.title: Pack Scheduler Mean Durations

panels.description: Rates of pack_bundle_crank_attempted outcomes with pack_block_cost and pack_txn_pending_smallest_cost.
panels.title: Pack Bundle Crank / CU State

panels.description: Address lookup table resolve outcome rates. Series: success = LUT resolved; invalid_lookup_index = LUT lookup index missing; account_uninitialized = LUT account not initialized; invalid_account_data = LUT account data invalid; invalid_account_owner = LUT account owned by wrong program; account_not_found = LUT account missing.
panels.title: Resolv LUT Results

panels.description: Execle pre-execution or non-landed outcome rates. Series: sanitize_failure = transactions that failed sanitize; unlanded = transactions that did not land.
panels.title: Execle Sanitize / Unlanded

panels.description: Execle transaction landing outcome rates. Series: success = transactions landed and succeeded; executed_failed = transactions landed and failed; fee_only = transactions that paid fee but did not execute; unlanded = transactions that did not land.
panels.title: Execle Transaction Outcomes

panels.description: Execle transaction error rates. Series: each line is a txn_result value; value is failed transactions with that result.
panels.title: Execle Errors (Top 5)

panels.description: Execle compute units. Series: cu/s = estimated compute units executed per second.
panels.title: Execle Compute Units

panels.description: Execle address lookup table error rates from txn_result. Series: address_lookup_table_not_found, invalid_address_lookup_table_owner, invalid_address_lookup_table_data, and invalid_address_lookup_table_index.
panels.title: Execle ALUT Errors

panels.description: Execle transaction regime time as a percentage of wall time per execle tile. Series: load, execute, and commit by execle tile id.
panels.title: Execle Transaction Regime %

panels.description: Execle VM regime time as a percentage of wall time per execle tile. Series: setup, commit, setup_cpi, commit_cpi, and interpreter by execle tile id.
panels.title: Execle VM Regime %

panels.description: Incoming shred processing result rates. Series: accepted = shreds accepted into incomplete FEC sets; completed = shreds that completed FEC sets.
panels.title: Shred Processing Results

panels.description: Shred reject/spill rates. Series: rejected_initial = rejected before allocation; rejected_unchained = non-chained merkle shreds; fec_rejected_fatal = fatal FEC rejection; fec_spilled = FEC sets spilled; microblocks_abandoned = microblocks abandoned on slot switch; bad_nonce = repair responses with an incorrect nonce.
panels.title: Shred Rejects & Spills

panels.description: Shred duration percentiles. Series: shredding_p50/p95/p99 = producing one FEC set; add_shred_p50/p95/p99 = verifying and processing one received shred.
panels.title: Shred Durations (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Replay processed rates. Series: transactions = slope of replay_chain_txn_height, the transaction count of the current fork (deriv, since it drops on a fork switch); slots = slots replayed successfully or leader slots packed and shredded successfully.
panels.title: Replay Processed Totals

panels.description: Signature latency percentiles. Series: sign_p50/p95/p99 = time to sign a message.
panels.title: Sign Duration (p50/p95/p99)

panels.description: Sign ops rate (sign_sign_duration_nanos_count) and mean sign duration (sum/count).
panels.title: Sign Throughput / Mean Duration

panels.description: Shred input and error rates. Series: turbine_rcv = turbine shreds received; repair_rcv = repair shreds received; bad_nonce = repair responses with an incorrect nonce; invalid_block_id = blocks created with unknown parent block id.
panels.title: Shred Input / Error Rates

panels.description: Mean shred durations from *_sum/*_count rate ratios.
panels.title: Shred Mean Durations
